mechanism.claim: During a high-variation completed hour, a four-of-six majority in liquid alt-perpetual aggressive taker flow opposed by BTC taker flow represents broad speculative demand or supply not yet transmitted to BTC; follow the alt-flow majority for six hours.
mechanism.side: strict majority sign of six alt taker-flow imbalances
mechanism.why_distinct: AFGI fits a 52-feature alt-flow geometry learner; CAFLR is a fixed, transparent cross-alt flow-majority versus BTC-flow disagreement event. CABER/CABLR use price returns, while CAFLR uses no price direction, funding, OI, premium, volume threshold, residual, or learned model.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC completed-hour realized-variation strict-prior rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse cross-alt-versus-BTC flow disagreement clocks are independent of Gross9 source rules

features.hour: exact bars_binance 1m paths [H-1h,H); all 60 timestamps for all seven symbols
features.flow: sum(2*taker_buy_quote-quote_asset_volume)/sum(quote_asset_volume) per symbol; denominator strictly positive; sign strict nonzero
features.breadth: at least four of six alt flow signs equal one strict sign
features.disagreement: BTC flow sign strict nonzero and opposite the qualifying alt majority
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared BTC 1m log(close/open)) over completed hour
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank among at most 720 prior valid hours; minimum 360; current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.availability: hour boundary after all exact paths complete

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent cross-alt aggressive-flow diffusion mechanism plus user-required high volatility

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no breadth, disagreement, hour, side, hold, timing, volatility, or subset repair
